parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key, 1 to 255 bytes of UTF-8, that makes this write safe to retry for 24 hours. A retry with the same key, credential, `Polymorfa-Version`, and request never runs the write again: it returns `409 idempotency_completed` when the original succeeded, or the original server error, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`. Reusing the key for a different request returns `409 idempotency_conflict`; a retry while the original is still running returns `409 idempotency_in_progress`, and a retry after an unrecorded outcome returns `409 idempotency_outcome_unknown`.

put.description:
**Protocols:** Meta Cloud API

**Required scope:** `groups:manage`

Replaces the group's profile picture. Send `multipart/form-data` with one `file` part: a square JPEG of at least 192 x 192 pixels and at most 5 MB. A `group.update` event with action `settings_updated` reports whether WhatsApp applied it. Repeating the same upload is safe. Beta: requires team enrollment and a Number with an Official API connection whose WhatsApp Business Account is an Official Business Account.

schema.description: Number ID.
Conversation ID of the group.

400.description: A parameter is invalid.

401.description: The credential is missing or invalid.

402.description: Account or billing restrictions prevent the request.

403.description: The credential lacks the scope, the team is not enrolled in the beta (`feature_unavailable`), the number is not eligible for groups (`whatsapp_groups_ineligible`), group creation is paused (`whatsapp_group_creation_paused`), or the group is suspended (`whatsapp_group_suspended`).

404.description: The Number or group is unavailable.

409.description: The Number has no Official API connection (`unsupported_for_connection`), or a WhatsApp group limit was reached (`whatsapp_group_limit_reached`, `whatsapp_group_full`).

413.description: The picture is larger than 5 MB (`media_too_large`).

429.description: WhatsApp is limiting group requests from this number (`whatsapp_rate_limited`).

502.description: WhatsApp's response could not be read.

503.description: A required service is unavailable. For a change, WhatsApp may have applied it: read the group before repeating it.

504.description: The reply deadline elapsed after dispatch (`result_unknown`). The picture may have changed; read the group before repeating the upload.

id.description: Opaque Polymorfa resource ID. Keep this value as a string.

whatsapp_id.description: Temporary singular provider reference for older consumers. Use whatsapp_ids for transport-specific references.

fromMe.description: True when the Number sent the message, including from another linked device.

type.description: Message type as delivered in `message.received`, for example `text` or `image`.

reactionTo.description: Opaque Polymorfa resource ID. Keep this value as a string.

allOf.description: Official API `order` messages: the cart as Meta reported it, when every line is readable.

media.description: Downloadable media for image, video, audio, document, and sticker messages. Empty when no copy is available.

state.description: `pending`: the copy is not stored yet. `stored`: `media` lists the copy. Every other state is final and no copy will be stored.

reason.description: Why a final state other than `stored` was reached, for example `provider_media_not_found` or `media_too_large`.

HistoryMediaRetrieval.description: Official API media only: whether a copy of the media was stored with this message.

id.description: Media ID. Download the bytes from `url` with a credential that has `media:read`.

url.description: Path of the media download method.

catalogId.description: Meta catalog ID the cart was built from.

text.description: Text the contact sent with the order.

CloudOrder.description: Present on `type: "order"` messages when every cart line is readable. There is no order total: multiply `quantity` by `itemPrice` per item if you need one. Prices and availability can differ from your catalog; confirm them before you fulfil the order.

productRetailerId.description: Your retailer ID (SKU), at most 256 UTF-8 bytes with no control characters.

itemPrice.description: Unit price as Meta reported it. Polymorfa does not convert or recompute it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code Meta reported for the item.

allOf.description: Author of an inbound group message.

id.description: Opaque Polymorfa resource ID. Keep this value as a string.

WhatsAppMessageIds.description: Exact message references observed through Linked Devices, the Official API, or both. Use the Polymorfa message id for actions and replies. Unknown provider references are omitted.

request_id.description: Matches the X-Request-Id response header. Include it when you contact support.

request_log_url.description: Console page that shows this request. Returned only to organization and project credentials whose request was logged.

data.description: Always null for a failed request.

accepted.description: WhatsApp accepted the request. Its outcome arrives as a `group.update` or `group.participant` event.

file.description: The picture: a square JPEG of at least 192 x 192 pixels and at most 5 MB.

id.description: Opaque Polymorfa resource ID. Keep this value as a string.
Opaque Polymorfa group ID. Keep it as a string.

state.description: `open`: the person messaged, reacted or called this Number through the Official API in the last 24 hours, so free-form messages can be sent. `closed`: no such activity in the last 24 hours; only approved templates can be sent, and Polymorfa refuses free-form sends with `conversation_window_closed`. `unknown`: Polymorfa cannot prove the window is closed; sends are passed to WhatsApp, which decides.

reason.description: Why the state is `unknown`, otherwise null. `not_tracked`: no WhatsApp notification has been processed for this connection yet. `tracking_started`: tracking began less than 24 hours ago. `notifications_interrupted`: a WhatsApp notification could not be processed in the last 24 hours. `identity_unlinked`: someone without a phone number (or username ID) wrote in during the last 24 hours and could be this person.

openedAt.description: When the person's latest known message, reaction or call started or reset the window. Null when none is known.

expiresAt.description: `openedAt` plus 24 hours. In the past when the window has closed.

previousCursor.description: Cursor for the preceding page of messages. Null when no preceding page exists.

id.description: Opaque Polymorfa resource ID. Keep this value as a string.

whatsapp_id.description: Temporary singular provider reference for older consumers. Use whatsapp_ids for transport-specific references.

previousCursor.description: Always null for conversations. Use nextCursor to continue listing.
